description: This file defines the interface UnivariateSolver for univariate root-finding algorithms in the Apache Commons Math library. It declares that implementations will search for a single zero within a given interval and extends the BaseUnivariateSolver interface parameterized with UnivariateFunction.

classes.name: UnivariateSolver
classes.description: Interface for univariate real root-finding algorithms, capable of searching for a single zero in a specified interval.
